legend: Langerhans cells with enlarged, deeply indented and convoluted nuclei with fine chromatin and indistinct nucleoli, from endobronchial ultrasound–guided transbronchial FNAB of an upper lobe lung nodule. Note the occasional eosinophils in the background. This case was BRAF p.V600E–mutant (liquid-based cytopathology, Pap).

Langerhans cells with markedly indented and convoluted nuclei and fine chromatin (note size comparison to the benign bronchial epithelial cell in the upper-right corner), from an endobronchial ultrasound–guided transbronchial FNAB of an upper lobe lung nodule. These cells were positive for CD1a (not shown), and molecular testing demonstrated the characteristic BRAF p.V600E mutation (liquid-based cytopathology, Pap).
